args: if [ -n "${WSL_INTEROP:-}" ] || grep -qi microsoft /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease 2>/dev/null; then case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "open-computer-use: unsupported WSL architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; exec "$(npm root -g)/open-computer-use/dist/windows/$arch/open-computer-use.exe" mcp; else exec open-computer-use mcp; fi
